question: Should Android adopt Kotlin 2.4.10 once both documented flavor builds and unit-test lanes pass on the exact PR head?
rationale: Automated source review finds no patch defect, but compiler-plugin adoption still requires the Android owner's acceptance of exact-project compatibility and generated-code behavior.

options.title: Validate both flavors, then merge
options.body: Require exact-head Play and third-party assemble plus unit-test success, then accept the shared 2.4.10 compiler-plugin pin.

options.title: Hold the compiler version
options.body: Keep Kotlin 2.4.0 and close or defer this update if the Android owner identifies an incompatibility or wants a later Kotlin patch.
